name: an-inch-of-red
description: Portable core for 《一寸红》 / An Inch of Red (codename 寻红). type=module makes every .js under game/ an ES module for Node, so scripts/test_core.mjs can import the exact same files the browser runs. Nothing here ships to a bundler.
comment: Deliberately no dependencies. The core must run in Node with zero install.
